title: SD GlucoNavii Glucose strips
subCategory: Gluco spark blood glucose test strips
desc: STANDARD™ GlucoNavii Blood Glucose Test Strips are disposable electrochemical biosensor strips that use GDH-FAD enzyme technology for accurate blood glucose measurement. The strips require only 0.5 µL of blood and provide results in approximately 5 seconds. They feature no-coding technology, helping reduce user errors while delivering fast, accurate, and reliable glucose testing for home and professional use.
throughput: 50 tests per vial (100 tests per 50T × 2 pack)
